text:
Raj Patel: FYI seeing a p99 jump ~10x for dedicated pool dedicated-east-4 starting ~2026-03-15T09:03:00Z after a client ramp. Customers reporting 10–20s p99 vs our usual ~1.2s. Opening thread to triage. Data from metrics: p95=1.1s, p99=12.4s (rolling 5m window 09:00–09:10).

Support - Lina: Escalated from CS — multiple customers hit 503/504 on the batch/generate endpoints. They included a few request IDs: rid=abc123, rid=def456, rid=ghi789. Said retries helped in some cases.

InfraBot: alert: dedicated.pool.latency.high triggered for pool=dedicated-east-4 at 1955551234.

Erin Gomez: Can you paste the pool config and confirm whether any deploys or infra work happened in the last 2 hours? Also region scale events?

Raj Patel: Pool config snapshot (from config-store):
```
pool: dedicated-east-4
min_replicas: 1
max_replicas: 50
scale_cooldown_secs: 90
scale_up_policy: cpu_threshold 70% / parallel_attach_limit 5
preload_model: false
warmup_hook: disabled
```
No model deploys or control-plane deploys in last 24h per CI logs.

Timothy Zhou: I'm pulling provisioner/kube events now. Early signs: many pod attach times very high (~7–9s) and model load times ~2–4s. Paste from provisioner logs (filtered):
```
2026-03-15T09:02:58Z provisioner: pod=rid-abc attach_time_ms=8200 gpu_attach_attempts=1 model_load_ms=2100 node=ded-east-4-node-27
2026-03-15T09:03:01Z provisioner: pod=rid-def attach_time_ms=7900 gpu_attach_attempts=1 model_load_ms=2300 node=ded-east-4-node-31
2026-03-15T09:03:05Z provisioner: pod=rid-ghi attach_time_ms=8300 gpu_attach_attempts=1 model_load_ms=2000 node=ded-east-4-node-27
```
Also seeing kube events: `Evicted` and `NodeReady:False` around the same time for a few nodes.

Erin Gomez: So attach + model load ~= 10–12s worst-case. With min_replicas=1 we're getting thundering-new-pods when traffic jumps. That matches p99. Two quick mitigations we can try now: bump min_replicas to 3 to keep hot GPUs, and run a targeted prewarm for the pool.

Scott M: Agreed. Immediate mitigations (quick checklist):
1) increase `min_replicas` to 3 for dedicated-east-4.
2) enable `preload_model=true` or trigger prewarm API for 2 extra replicas.
3) route heavy customers temporarily to smaller/quantized model pool if available.
4) increase autoscaler cooldown to avoid oscillation while nodes recover.

I can push (1) and (2) manually.

Raj Patel: Executing prewarm now for 2 slots. Using internal admin API:
```
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/pools/dedicated-east-4/prewarm" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"count":2,"model":"gpt-small-q4_0"}'
```
Response: `{ "job_id": "prewarm-20260315-01", "status": "started" }`

InfraBot: prewarm job prewarm-20260315-01 started for pool dedicated-east-4.

Support - Lina: Quick update from customers — after the prewarm and bumping min_replicas ->3 we're seeing p99 drop to ~2.9s for the affected requests (couple of customers confirm). Things look much better but we should keep monitoring for stability. :thumbsup:

Erin Gomez: Good. We should still find root cause for the high attach times. Timothy, can you check node lifecycle / cloud provider events for that timeframe (evictions/spot terminations/kernel OOMs)? Also check whether node autoscaler replaced nodes causing many pods to reattach.

Timothy Zhou: Pulled node group events. Found a burst of node replacements in the nodepool `ded-east-4-bg-spot` between 09:00–09:04 — cloud provider shows several spot preemptions causing node drains. Also saw a couple kernel OOM messages on node-27 before restart. So root cause looks like node churn causing pods to reschedule and trigger GPU attach + model reloads.

Scott M: That makes sense. When nodes die, we lose warmed model caches and GPUs need fresh attach. Two medium-term fixes I suggest:
- create a small warm-buffer (static) in each zone: min 2 GPUs reserved for warmed workers (warm pool).
- set autoscaler cooldown to 180s to reduce oscillation from short-lived terminations.
- add attach_time_ms telemetry (histogram) and an alert: p95_attach_time > 2s for 5m.
- implement fast-fallback routing to quantized variants when attach_time alerts fire.

Erin Gomez: Also we should add a runbook snippet for CS/Support to run prewarm quickly (curl command above) and a checklist for when to temporarily bump min_replicas. I'll add that to our on-call runbook.

Raj Patel: Action items (owners):
- Scott: schedule warm-buffer rollout + PR for config (warm buffer config + cloud tags).
- Erin: change autoscaler cooldown to 180s for dedicated pools (staged change).
- Timothy: add attach_time metric, dashboard, and alert (p95>2s).
- Support - Lina: add prewarm snippet and routing checklist to runbook, update customers.
- Raj: customer comms + confirm p99 stability for next 2 hours.

Support - Lina: I'll draft comms to the affected customers now and ask for confirmation once p99 holds.

Scott M: ack. I'll open PR for warm-buffer and include a canary rollout plan.

Raj Patel: Closing the immediate escalation — status: mitigated (prewarm + min_replicas bump). Will keep monitoring and follow up on the action items. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

Timothy Zhou: Filing follow-up ticket INFRA-4519 for warm buffer + attach_time alerts.

Erin Gomez: Nice triage everyone, saved a bunch of customer pain.

InfraBot: incident note: mitigation applied by Raj Patel at 1955551460 (prewarm + min_replicas=3).
